proposals.evidence: Platts derives ćarbī “fat, grease, suet, tallow” from Persian ćarb; the existing Hindi carbī attestation supports the whole regional loan word. Pothwari cɛrvī and Gujari cɛrbī/cɛrvī retain this consonant sequence with b/v alternation; both members of the selected slash response belong to the same family. The borrowed link preserves the provisional regional Hindi/Urdu route rather than asserting direct Persian contact for each language.
